items.title: Software Engineer
items.subTitle: Web, Mobile, and API
data: Designed, implemented, and tested multiple software applications and products.

Formed a media library to store company files online securely and conveniently using Angular 2 alpha builds and the back-end using a REST API with ASP.net Core, Azure table storage, and Azure blob storage.

Constructed multiple additions to an AngularJS enterprise web application including a dynamic email builder, text message builder, customer selector, and document signing interface with a CouchDB and CosmosDB based file system.

Created and introduced a new mobile wallet application built with Ionic and Angular called EMoney. Facilitated production and development build deployment to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
Gained knowledge of the Agile project management style and developed complex web applications.
